ad.title: Quality Assurance Engineer
ad.description:
Here is the cleaned-up, well-formatted version of the job description for easy reading and presentation:

Role Overview

As a Quality Assurance Engineer at HOPE Technik, you will play a vital role in maintaining the quality and reliability of innovative products across robotics, automation, and special vehicle projects. This hands-on role involves testing, analyzing, and improving products to ensure they consistently meet rigorous standards and specifications.

Key Responsibilities

1. Quality Testing and Validation

  • Test Planning: Formulate comprehensive test plans and thoroughly test products and components to ensure they meet predefined quality standards.

  • Protocol Development: Develop and implement testing protocols and procedures across various stages of product development.

  • Execution: Utilize a strategic mix of both manual and automated testing techniques.

2. Issue Identification and Resolution

  • Defect Detection: Proactively identify defects, bugs, or inconsistencies in products and engineering processes.

  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Collaborate with the product development team to deeply understand requirements and ensure quality considerations are integrated from the start.

  • Problem Solving: Provide actionable insights, root-cause analyses, and recommendations to resolve quality issues effectively.

3. Continuous Improvement

  • Process Enhancement: Participate in continuous improvement initiatives to boost overall product quality and production efficiency.

  • Data Analysis: Analyze QA data and feedback loops to identify patterns, trends, and systemic areas for improvement.

  • Best Practices: Recommend modifications to products or processes based on findings and current industry best practices.

4. Documentation and Reporting

  • Record Keeping: Maintain meticulous and accurate records of testing procedures, methodologies, and test results.

  • Reporting: Prepare detailed reports on quality assurance activities, findings, and overall project progress for management.

  • Compliance: Ensure all documentation complies with industry standards, regulatory requirements, and company policies.

5. Collaboration and Communication

  • Lifecycle Integration: Work closely with design, production, and software development teams to seamlessly integrate QA into all phases of the product development lifecycle.

  • Stakeholder Management: Communicate effectively with team members, management, and external stakeholders regarding quality metrics, objectives, and outcomes.

  • Team Participation: Actively participate in regular team meetings and provide clear, concise updates on QA progress.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Quality Assurance, or a related technical field.

  • Experience: Proven track record as a Quality Assurance Engineer or in a similar role—ideally with direct experience in robotics, automation, or vehicle engineering.

  • QA Expertise: Strong core understanding of quality assurance methodologies, tools, and industry standards.

  • Technical Skills: Hands-on experience with statistical analysis and specialized quality testing tools; strong troubleshooting and root-cause analysis capabilities.

  • Soft Skills: High attention to detail, exceptional problem-solving abilities, strong organizational skills, and excellent teamwork and communication capabilities.

  • Bonus: Knowledge of industry-specific regulations and standards is highly advantageous.

ad.title: Integrated Logistics Support (ILS) Lead
ad.description:
Role Summary

The Integrated Logistics Support (ILS) Lead is responsible for planning, developing, and managing all ILS activities across programs (especially Defence) to ensure systems, vehicles, equipment, and platforms achieve required operational availability, maintainability, reliability, and lifecycle supportability.

This role ensures the delivered system can be effectively operated, maintained, repaired, and sustained throughout its service life in accordance with customer requirements.

The ILS Lead works closely with engineering, operations, field support, supply chain, quality, training, and customers to establish a complete support ecosystem from design phase through in-service support.

Key Responsibilities

1. ILS Strategy & Planning

  • Develop and execute the overall ILS strategy for defence programs

  • Prepare and manage the ILS Plan (ILSP)

  • Ensure compliance with customer ILS requirements, standards, and contractual obligations

  • Define lifecycle support concepts from development to end-of-life disposal

  • Establish maintenance philosophy and support concepts (Organisational, Intermediate, Depot level maintenance)

  • Participate in design reviews to ensure supportability is built into the product from the beginning

2. Reliability, Availability & Maintainability (RAM)

  • Perform RAM analysis for systems and subsystems

  • Calculate and manage:

    • MTBF (Mean Time Between Failure)

    • MTTR (Mean Time To Repair)

    • MTTF (Mean Time To Failure)

    • Availability (Ao / Ai)

    • Reliability growth targets

    • Failure rate analysis

  • Conduct Failure Modes, Effects and Criticality Analysis (FMECA)

  • Conduct Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM) studies

  • Support root cause analysis for field failures and recurring faults

  • Recommend design improvements to improve reliability and maintainability

3. Maintenance Planning

  • Develop preventive, corrective, and predictive maintenance strategies

  • Establish scheduled maintenance intervals and inspection plans

  • Define maintenance task analysis (MTA)

  • Determine manpower, tooling, facilities, and infrastructure requirements

  • Plan workshop layout, repair bays, storage areas, and maintenance space requirements

  • Define calibration requirements and support equipment needs

  • Develop maintenance resource planning for fleet sustainment

4. Spare Parts & Supply Support

  • Develop Initial Provisioning Lists (IPL)

  • Determine Recommended Spare Parts Lists (RSPL)

  • Plan Lay-In Spares (LIS)

  • Establish sparing philosophy and inventory optimisation

  • Define repairable vs consumable parts strategy

  • Forecast demand and lifecycle spare requirements

  • Coordinate with procurement and supply chain for support readiness

5. Technical Documentation

  • Lead development of:

    • Maintenance manuals

    • Operator manuals

    • Illustrated Parts Catalogues (IPC)

    • Troubleshooting guides

    • Repair procedures

    • Service bulletins

    • Configuration records

  • Ensure technical publications meet defence standards and audit requirements

  • Manage document revisions and change control

6. Training & Capability Development

  • Develop operator and maintainer training plans

  • Conduct Training Needs Analysis (TNA)

  • Define competency requirements for maintenance crews

  • Establish training syllabus, lesson plans, and practical assessments

  • Support train-the-trainer programs

  • Build long-term maintenance capability for customer teams

7. After-Sales Support & Service Operations

  • Lead post-delivery support operations

  • Establish issue ticketing, incident reporting, and fault escalation processes

  • Manage defect reporting and corrective action systems

  • Coordinate warranty support and field service response

  • Support service-level agreement (SLA) performance management

  • Track fleet health, service KPIs, and support performance

8. Customer & Stakeholder Management

  • Serve as primary ILS interface with defence customers

  • Present ILS status, RAM performance, and sustainment plans

  • Support tender submissions, technical proposals, and audits

  • Participate in customer reviews, acceptance testing, and sustainment discussions

  • Manage subcontractors and OEM support partners where required

9. Team Leadership

  • Lead and mentor an ILS team of approximately 5 personnel

  • Allocate tasks across RAM, spares, documentation, and field support activities

  • Develop team capability and ILS best practices

  • Drive continuous improvement across lifecycle support processes


Requirements

Education

  • Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Logistics Engineering, or related field

Experience

  • 8–15 years of experience in defence programs, aerospace, military vehicles, special vehicles, or complex engineering systems

  • Strong experience in ILS, RAM, maintenance engineering, or sustainment programs

  • Familiarity with Singapore defence customer expectations and ILS practices preferred

Technical Knowledge

Strong knowledge of:

  • ILS methodology

  • MIL-STD / DEF-STAN / ASD standards

  • RAM engineering

  • FMECA / RCM / LORA / MTA

  • Obsolescence management

  • Configuration management

  • Lifecycle cost (LCC) analysis

  • Maintenance planning systems

  • Defence documentation standards

  • ERP / CMMS / maintenance ticketing systems

Preferred Skills

  • Strong leadership and stakeholder management

  • Strong customer-facing communication skills

  • Good commercial understanding of lifecycle support contracts

  • Ability to work across engineering and operations teams

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving ability

ad.title: Duty Manager (Islandwide)
ad.description:
Job Expectations

  • Responsible for ensuring the proper, efficient, and profitable functioning of the Hotel.
  • Supervise sections in the Front Office, including reception, cashier, telephone, reservation, and baggage services. Monitor staff members’ conduct and job performance and to project a positive corporate image to guests.
  • Provide prompt, courteous, and efficient service to guests and handle guest complaints with tact and diplomacy. Assist in guest check-ins and check-outs.
  • Assist in inspecting rooms assigned to VIPs before their arrival, escort VIPs to their rooms and ensure complimentary amenities are provided. Inform relevant departments about VIPs’ arrival.
  • Check the Logbook for messages and follow up actions at the beginning of each shift.  Issue keys to authorized personnel only and initiate correspondence regarding enquiries, reservations, and complaints. Monitor housekeeping discrepancy reports and take corrective actions when necessary.
  • Handle security-related matters, such as directing guests reporting incidents or theft and addressing guest conduct issues with the Security Department.
  • Maintain the cash float amount according to expected occupancy. Authorize rate and room changes, paid outs, cash advances, and acceptance of cheques following procedures and credit policies.
  • Take charge of training all reception staff members, include planning, organizing and conducting on-the-job training.
  • Conduct spot checks on outlets in the absence of the Outlet Manager.
  • Monitor room inventory closely to maximize room utilization and generate higher revenue. Collaborate with Sales to optimize revenue and occupancy from group allotments.
  • Take on the responsibility of evacuating staff members and guests during a fire in the absence of the Safety & Fire Manager. Attend CERT training as required by law and regulations.
  • Perform any other duties assigned by supervisors, carrying them out diligently and professionally.

Requirements

  • Minimum Diploma in Hospitality, Tourism, or related field.
  • At least 2–3 years of Front Office or supervisory experience in the hotel industry.
  • Proficient in Opera PMS or other hotel management systems.
  • Hospitality certifications (e.g., CERT, service excellence, leadership, or operations) are an advantage.
  • Strong leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Service-oriented with the ability to handle guest feedback and operational issues effectively.
  • Well-groomed and professional in appearance and demeanor.
  • Willing to work rotating shifts, weekends, and public holidays.

 

Locations Available: 

  • The Barracks Hotel Sentosa
  • The Outpost Hotel Sentosa
  • Oasia Resort Sentosa
  • Village Hotel Sentosa

ad.title: Assistant Manager, Email and Loyalty Marketing
ad.description:
We are looking for a hands-on and analytical marketer to support and grow our membership and loyalty ecosystem. This role is responsible for executing lifecycle strategies, improving member engagement, and contributing to the commercial performance of the loyalty programme. You will work closely with senior stakeholders across marketing, revenue, operations and finance to strengthen member acquisition, engagement and retention through CRM and marketing automation.

Loyalty Program Management

  • Support the development and execution of the loyalty program roadmaps to drive member growth and repeat stays
  • Monitor programme KPIs including member acquisition, activation, retention, tier progression and revenue contribution.
  • Manage day-to-day operations of programs including member enrolment flows, benefits configuration and campaign setup.
  • Track points accrual and redemption trends, and support liability monitoring and breakage analysis in partnership with Finance.
  • Assist in evaluating programme enhancements based on performance data and competitor benchmarking.

CRM & Lifecycle Marketing

  • Build and optimize automated lifecycle journeys across onboarding, pre-stay, post-stay, win-back and tier upgrade triggers.
  • Execute email and CRM campaigns including segmentation, personalization and dynamic content deployment.
  • Conduct A/B testing on subject lines, creative, offers and journey logic to improve engagement and conversion.
  • Monitor email deliverability, database health and compliance with data regulations.

Campaign Execution & Member Growth

  • Plan and execute loyalty-led campaigns to drive member acquisition, points earning and redemption.
  • Collaborate with brand, digital marketing and property teams to ensure loyalty messaging is integrated into broader campaigns.
  • Support tactical promotions that stimulate member activity while maintaining commercial discipline.

Analytics & Reporting

  • Track and report regular insights on member behaviour, revenue contribution and campaign performance using CRM dashboards, Google Analytics and business intelligence tools.
  • Maintain dashboards that track loyalty KPIs and campaign ROI.

Governance & Stakeholder Support

  • Maintain CRM data accuracy through routine audits and quality checks.
  • Develop and update SOPs and any documentation related to loyalty programme and emai marketing operations.
  • Support onboarding and training of property teams on loyalty processes and systems.
  • Liaise with CRM vendors or internal tech teams on basic troubleshooting and system enhancements.
  • Perform any other duties assigned by supervisor, carrying them out diligently and professionally. 
Requirements
  • Degree in Business, Marketing, Hospitality, or a related field.
  • Minimum 4-6 years of work experience in loyalty programme management and marketing
  • Hands-on experience with both CRM systems and marketing automation systems
  • Detail-oriented with good operational discipline
  • Strong copywriting and analytical skills
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally and managing multiple campaigns simultaneously

Far East Organization is a Christian Enterprise, which develops real estate and operates businesses by serving with grace, love, integrity and honesty. Together with its Hong Kong-based sister company Sino Group, they are one of Asia’s largest real estate groups, with operations in Singapore, Malaysia, Australia, Japan, China (Mainland and Hong Kong) and USA.

Far East Organization is the largest private property developer in Singapore, having developed over 780 developments across all segments of real estate including 55,000 private homes in Singapore since its establishment in 1960. Far East Organization includes three listed entities: Far East Orchard Limited, Far East Hospitality Trust and Yeo Hiap Seng Limited.

Far East Organization is the winner of 14 FIABCI World Prix d’Excellence awards, the highest honour in international real estate. In 2022, Far East Organization is listed as top 50 of The Straits Time’s Singapore Best Employers Study. We believe in taking care of the total well-being of our people as they grow with us. We nurture a community where talent is developed and recognised, innovative ideas are encouraged, and achievements celebrated.Our health and well-being benefits provide physical, mental and spiritual support to our people and their families. In addition to annual leave, performance bonus, medical and insurance coverage, you can anticipate the provision of birthday leave, birthday benefits, care leave, flexible benefits, staff rebates at F&B outlets, and special rates at our hotels, both locally and overseas. We empower you in your engagement with the wider community by providing varied activities to experience different opportunities to serve and contribute to the community.


Responsibilities

  • Ensure smooth running of all building Mechanical and Electrical services

  • Update the stock quantity of the maintenance materials regularly

Requirements

  • NITEC in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering or equivalent
  • Versatile and able to do carpentry works
  • Able to do shift work

Requirements

  • 3–7 years of relevant experience in infrastructure operations, implementation, and/or support (level dependent).
  • Strong working knowledge in: networking, servers, cloud, identity, Microsoft 365, backup/DR, monitoring, and security controls.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure and infrastructure security practices is preferred.
  • Certifications are a plus: CCNA, CompTIA Network+/Security+, ITIL Foundation, Microsoft Azure certifications, security certifications (CCSP/GSEC).
  • Strong documentation, problem-solving, and stakeholder communication skills.

ad.title: Technician (Laundry)
ad.description:
About Us


Agape Services is a Christian social enterprise under Far East Organization, whose aim is to provide meaningful employment and benefits to people with disadvantaged background, as a demonstration of the love and teachings of Jesus Christ.


 


Agape Services offer services in Agape Cleaning, Agape Laundry as well as moving and disposal. We aim to provide employment through our services to the disadvantaged who would otherwise not be able to cope in a regular work environment.


Responsibilities


Maintain tunnel washer, washer extractor and dryers to keep laundry machinary and equipment in operational condition.


Troubleshoot and repair inoperative machines.


Provide support and assistance by responding appropriately to repair situations, assessing the problem, and taking the appropriate action.


Perform preventative maintenance and cleaning of machine ductwork and related equipment.


Maintain an inventory of tools and supplies necessary for the completion of repairs, and keep tools in good condition.


Requirements


Minimum NITEC in Electrical Engineering / Mechanical Engineering or equivalent.


General mechanical, diagnostic, and troubleshooting abilities.

ad.title: Leasing Professional (Retail)
ad.description:
About Us


Far East Organization is a Christian Enterprise, which develops real estate and operates businesses by serving with grace, love, integrity and honesty. Together with its Hong Kong-based sister company Sino Group, they are one of Asia’s largest real estate groups, with operations in Singapore, Malaysia, Australia, Japan, China (Mainland and Hong Kong) and USA. 

Far East Organization is the largest private property developer in Singapore, having developed over 780 developments across all segments of real estate including 55,000 private homes in Singapore since its establishment in 1960. Far East Organization includes three listed entities: Far East Orchard Limited, Far East Hospitality Trust and Yeo Hiap Seng Limited. 

Far East Organization is the winner of 14 FIABCI World Prix d’Excellence awards, the highest honour in international real estate. In 2022, Far East Organization is listed as top 50 of The Straits Time’s Singapore Best Employers Study. We believe in taking care of the total well-being of our people as they grow with us. We nurture a community where talent is developed and recognised, innovative ideas are encouraged, and achievements celebrated. 

Our health and well-being benefits provide physical, mental and spiritual support to our people and their families. In addition to annual leave, performance bonus, medical and insurance coverage, you can anticipate the provision of birthday leave, birthday benefits, care leave, flexible benefits, staff rebates at F&B outlets, and special rates at our hotels, both locally and overseas. We empower you in your engagement with the wider community by providing varied activities to experience different opportunities to serve and contribute to the community.


Responsibilities

Team member of varying years of experiences are entrusted with identifying and engaging potential tenants through a blend of insightful market research, effective networking, and proactive outreach efforts.

 

As a manager, you will be responsible for guiding and mentoring a team. Your responsibilities include supervising the execution of leasing strategies, with a focus on maximising rental income and occupancy rates.

Requirements

The ideal candidate holds a Diploma in Real Estate, Business, or a related field, with varying levels of experience tailored to the respective roles. Candidates with RES License preferred.

 

Candidates with no experience and eager to kickstart their careers are welcome to apply, while seasoned professionals with experience in retail/commercial leasing can bring invaluable expertise to the table.

 

Importantly, you possess strong negotiation and communication skills, and the ability to build relationships with diverse stakeholders. You are also detail-oriented as leasing professionals are responsible for finalising lease agreements and other essential documentation.

ad.title: Financial Controller
ad.description:
Responsibilities

Reporting to the CFO, the Financial Controller (“FC”) is responsible for group-level financial control, statutory and management reporting, governance, and compliance across Far East Orchard Limited (“FEOR”) and its subsidiaries.

 

1.    Group Financial Reporting & Close
•    Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close at group level, ensuring adherence to reporting timelines and accounting standards.
•    Oversee group consolidation and ensure accuracy of eliminations and group journals.
•    Review and support the preparation of statutory and management financial statements and analyses.
•    Coordinate and direct the preparation of regulatory reporting, including quarterly and year-end reporting to SGX.
•    Ensure financial statements are prepared in accordance with applicable accounting standards, SGX requirements, and group accounting policies.

 

2.    Governance, Controls & Compliance
•    Establish and maintain strong group financial controls, ensuring consistency and discipline across entities and regions.
•    Review and sign off group-level compliance and Negative Assurance Checklists (NACs), and oversee entity-level compliance reviews.
•    Act as the primary finance counterpart for external auditors, internal audit, and regulators, managing audit planning, execution, and issue resolution.
•    Ensure compliance with accounting standards, loan covenants, and regulatory requirements across jurisdictions.
•    Ensure compliance with interested person transaction (IPT) requirements and related disclosures.

 

3.    Budgeting, Forecasting & Management Reporting
•    Oversee the preparation and review of annual group budgets and rolling forecasts (P&L, cash flow, and capex), including coordination and review of business units’ budgets; analyse and report variances.
•    Review consolidated forecasts, key assumptions, and performance drivers.
•    Review management reports, variance analyses, and performance commentary for CFO and EXCO review.
•    Provide financial insight and analysis to support strategic initiatives, investment decisions, and capital allocation.

 

4.    Treasury, Tax & Risk Oversight
•    Oversee treasury management and reporting, liquidity monitoring, and covenant compliance.
•    Oversee tax team, including filings and compliance matters and coordination with external tax advisors.
•    Support the CFO in financial risk identification, mitigation, and scenario analysis as required.

 

5.    Stakeholder & Board Support
•    Support the CFO in the preparation of Board and ARC papers, including financial results, audit matters, accounting judgments, and governance disclosures.
•    Act as a key finance point-of-contact for senior management, auditors, and key external stakeholders on group-wide financial reporting and control matters.
•    Contribute to group initiatives, business integration, and finance transformation projects as required.

 

6.    Finance Leadership & Capability Building
•    Lead and develop the finance team, including Controllers/Managers and shared service teams where applicable.
•    Provide clear oversight, coaching, and performance management to ensure high professional standards.
•    Drive continuous improvement in financial reporting processes, systems, and controls.
•    Support finance transformation initiatives, including systems upgrades and standardisation efforts.
•    Foster a strong culture of accountability, accuracy, and continuous improvement.

Requirements

  • Degree in Accountancy or related discipline
  • Professional accounting qualification (e.g. CA, ACCA, or equivalent)
  • Minimum 10–12 years of relevant finance experience; ideally with 8–10 years in a Big 4 accounting firm
  • Experience of working in a SGX-listed group, real estate, hospitality, or lodging businesses is a definite advantage
  • Strong knowledge and experience in financial reporting standards, consolidations, and internal controls
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; meticulous and detail-oriented
  • Ability to interpret complex financial information and communicate clearly to senior management and board members
  • High integrity and firm on controls
  • Able to operate at both strategic and hands-on levels
  • Confident in managing senior stakeholders and external advisors
  • Calm under pressure, with sound judgment in sensitive and time-critical matters
  • Proven leadership in a similar setting
  • Strong interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills
  • Good business acumen and highly adaptive
  • Mature, proactive, resourceful and hands-on with good initiative
  • Works well independently with minimal supervision, while remaining a strong team player
  • Able to multitask and deliver under multiple tight deadlines

ad.title: AI Engineer (Group IT)
ad.description:
The Group IT Data Team’s vision is to establish scalable, enterprise-grade AI solutions that enhance operational efficiency, unlock new business value, and accelerate digital transformation across business units. The team consists of forward-thinking engineers, data specialists, and technologists, working closely with business stakeholders to deliver impactful AI-driven solutions.

The AI Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, and deploying AI-driven applications, with a primary focus on Generative AI (GenAI) and Large Language Models (LLMs).

 

The role will collaborate with business and technology teams to identify use cases, translate requirements into AI solutions, and deliver scalable, secure, and production-ready applications. Over time, the role will also expand into broader machine learning and advanced analytics initiatives.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and deploy GenAI/LLM-based applications such as copilots, chatbots, search, and knowledge assistants.
  • Work with enterprise platforms (e.g., Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Services, SAP AI capabilities) to build and integrate AI solutions.
  • Translate business use cases into AI solution architectures, including prompt design, orchestration, and API integration.
  • Able to conduct data analysis and data engineering/modelling to prepare data for model training.
  • Develop and manage end-to-end AI pipelines, including data ingestion, preprocessing, embedding, model interaction, and output validation.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (business users, IT, vendors) to ensure AI solutions align with operational needs and enterprise architecture.
  • Ensure responsible AI practices, including governance, security, data privacy, and model evaluation.
  • Improve and maintain AI systems for performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.
  • Stay updated with emerging AI technologies and continuously enhance the organization’s AI capabilities.
  • Gradually expand into machine learning model development, predictive analytics, and advanced data science use cases.

Requirements

  • Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent, with at least 2–5 years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or AI/ML-related roles.
  • Hands-on experience or strong exposure to GenAI/LLM technologies (e.g., Azure OpenAI, LangChain, prompt engineering).
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (preferably Azure) and API-based system integration.
  • Experience in programming languages such as Python, JavaScript, or similar.
  • Understanding of data concepts including data pipelines, embeddings, vector databases, and APIs.
  • Proficiency in advance SQL and major data platforms (relational, cloud data warehouse and big data tools)
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to translate business needs into technical solutions.
  • Exposure to SAP ecosystem or enterprise systems integration is an advantage.
  • Understanding of machine learning concepts and willingness to grow into ML model development.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams.
  • Self-driven, adaptable, and keen to learn emerging AI technologies.

As part of Intrepid’s end-to-end eCommerce ecosystem, we gain broad exposure across operations, collaborate with cross-functional experts, and play a key role in shaping how brands connect with digital shoppers in real time.

As an Affiliate Associate/Senior Associate You Will Take Charge Of

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute affiliate marketing strategies to drive brand awareness, engagement, and sales on TikTok.



  • Identify and recruit TikTok influencers and content creators to join our affiliate program.



  • Build and maintain strong relationships with affiliate partners, providing support, guidance, and incentives to drive performance.



  • Create and optimize TikTok content in collaboration with affiliates to align with brand messaging and objectives.



  • Monitor and analyze TikTok campaigns, tracking key metrics and performance indicators to optimize results.

  • Stay up-to-date with TikTok trends, algorithms, and best practices to maximize visibility and reach.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including marketing, sales, and product development, to ensure alignment and coherence in brand messaging and strategy.

What We Are Looking For - The Ideal Profile

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field.

  • Experience: Proven experience in affiliate marketing, influencer relations, or digital marketing, with a focus on TikTok.

  • Platform Knowledge: Strong understanding of TikTok's platform, features, trends, and algorithms.

  • Communication: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with influencers and partners.

  • Creativity: Creative mindset with a keen eye for engaging content and storytelling.

  • Analytical Skills: Analytical mindset, with the ability to track and analyze campaign performance metrics to drive optimization.

  • Mindset: Self-motivated and results-driven, with the ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.

In Return, You Will Be Getting


  • High-Level Exposure: You will work with our portfolio of leading international brands, delivering engaging livestreams and video content to the highest standards. Many of our team members have gone on to become key brand ambassadors—the world is truly your oyster!

  • End-to-End Expertise: We believe in an omni-channel and full-funnel approach. Intrepid is one of the few players offering a full array of services under one roof, providing you with wide exposure and exciting growth opportunities.

  • Data-Driven Creativity: We combine creative genius with a data-driven approach. You will have the data and knowledge to analyze and optimize at your fingertips, allowing you to add that spark of creative brilliance to create magic.

  • International Stability: We are a proven international company with a strong track record. You will benefit from regional exposure and best practices while working in a fast-moving, collaborative culture with no politics.

Beyond technical execution, the role supports livestream campaigns aligned with platform promotions and brand objectives, contributing to key performance metrics such as viewer engagement, traffic, and conversion.

  • Lead the technical setup and execution of livestream sessions across multiple brand accounts on platforms such as TikTok Shop, Shopee Live.

  • Maintain full studio readiness, including equipment organization, cleanliness, and functional setup for livestream sessions.

  • Track equipment usage and conduct routine maintenance to ensure all production equipment remains in optimal working condition.
  • Plan and supervise equipment upgrades or purchases to support evolving livestream production needs.
  • Conduct daily and weekly technical checks to minimize last-minute issues before livestream sessions.

Livestream Quality Optimization

  • Identify recurring technical issues during livestream sessions and implement preventive solutions to reduce disruptions.
  • Monitor production quality across livestream sessions and recommend improvements aligned with market standards.
  • Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) for livestream technical setup, studio operations, and troubleshooting.
  • Document best practices for livestream production, equipment configuration, and technical workflows.
  • Support the team in improving livestream production efficiency and scalability across multiple brands.

Team Supervision & Development

  • Supervise and mentor Production Assistants to maintain consistent livestream production standards.
  • Assign tasks and coordinate production schedules to support multiple brand livestream campaigns.
  • Train team members on studio equipment, livestream tools, and operational best practices.
  • Ensure adherence to production standards, technical workflows, and studio operational procedures.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Social Commerce Account Managers, hosts, and marketing teams to ensure livestream production aligns with brand campaign objectives.
  • Support commercial teams in delivering high-impact livestream sessions during platform campaigns and promotional events.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to maintain consistent production quality across different brands and livestream formats.
  • Contribute insights on production improvements based on livestream execution experience.

Experience & Competencies

  • 3+ years of experience in livestream production, studio operations, or video production within ecommerce, social commerce, or digital media.
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of livestream production tools such as OBS, vMix, or similar streaming systems.
  • Practical experience with camera operations, lighting setup, and audio engineering.
  • Familiarity with social commerce livestream platforms such as TikTok Shop, Shopee Live
  • Experience managing studio equipment and maintaining production inventory systems.
  • Prior experience supervising production assistants or technical teams is a plus.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and ability to resolve technical issues under time pressure.

  • Highly adaptable and comfortable working in fast-paced livestream environments.
  • Detail-oriented, organized, and proactive in maintaining studio readiness.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to react quickly during live sessions.

As a Key Account Manager, you will be responsible for managing and growing the ecommerce business of one or multiple brands across all ecommerce platforms in Malaysia. As the brand’s main point of contact and trusted advisor, you create the ecommerce strategy and annual plans for your brands and take ownership of their business like it is yours. You negotiate with brand and platform stakeholders to maximize the attractiveness of propositions for consumers and exposure for the brand, in order to grow the business. As a Key Account Manager, you will take charge of

  • Grow Account NMV and Revenue:
    • Develop and implement strategies to increase the Net Merchandise Value (NMV) and overall revenue of key accounts.

    • Ensure all brand / store KPIs are met
  • Promo Planning / Alignment:
    • Develop and execute promotional plans in collaboration with marketing and sales teams.
    • Ensure alignment of promotional activities with overall business goals and account strategies.
    • Coordinate with internal stakeholders to ensure seamless execution of promotions.
  • Client Coordination:
    • Build and maintain strong relationships with key account clients.
    • Address client inquiries and concerns promptly, ensuring high levels of satisfaction.
    • Understand client needs and work to exceed their expectations.
  • Platform Coordination:
    • Act as the primary liaison between the company and platform partners, ensuring smooth communication and collaboration.
    • Coordinate platform-specific activities and initiatives to maximize account performance.
  • Cross-Functional Team Coordination:
    • Collaborate with various internal teams, including customer experience (CX), operations (Ops), Graphic Design (GD), finance, to ensure cohesive account management.
    • Facilitate communication and cooperation among cross-functional teams to support account goals.
    • Coach and develop junior team members

What we are looking for - the ideal profile

  • Min 2-3 years of relevant work experience in Ecommerce, ideally with a platform (Lazada / Shopee), with another enabler, or with a brand or distributor
  • Commercial performance-driven mindset, flexible & collaborative attitude, looking to make an impact and thriving in a fast-paced start-up environment
  • Strong interpersonal, relationship and communication, listening and negotiation skills
  • Ability to develop a brand ecommerce strategy and translate this into annual & monthly activation plans
  • Experience in developing digital / ecommerce campaign plans
  • Analytical skills to analyze data and make performance improvement suggestions
  • Project management experience
  • Good Excel and PowerPoint skills

In return, you will be getting

  • We work with the most ambitious leading brands in ecommerce across South East Asia and the brand management team is the key interface between brands and our different in-house teams. In this role, you will have the most holistic overview of all facets of driving a successful e-commerce business
  • From Junior KAM to KAM to Senior KAM to Cluster Manager and beyond, this team offers a lot of opportunities for career progression and personal development, with increasing commercial and team management responsibilities
  • Advanced systems and tools support you in running the stores of our clients, so you can focus your time on analyses, planning and initiatives that have the highest impact
  • Brand Management is a very diverse discipline, from honing your analytical and commercial skills to communication, stakeholder management and negotiation, you will get to do it all and learn from a collaborative and supportive team of experts

We also offer

  • Best of Both Worlds

    We are a scale up: the sophistication of a small multinational, with the agility of a start-up. This means you get to work on cutting-edge projects, and besides your 'standard' job description, we love to see you show entrepreneurial initiative and want to see your take on how you can take your role and our company to the next level. Good ideas get implemented. You are the master of your own destiny.

  • Culture that Brings Out the Best

    At Intrepid, culture is not just a buzzword, it is what we practice at work every day. We believe in collaboration over competition, transparency over politics, and willingness to learn over ego. You will be part of a team where people genuinely support one another, celebrate wins together, and face challenges head-on as one. We put our all into the work but we balance it with fun, whether that is through team lunches, after-work hangouts, events or shared laughter in the office. This is a place where you can thrive professionally while having a great time.

  • Grow Without Limits

    Learning at Intrepid is constant and dynamic. You will have access to formal training through face-to-face sessions, coaching and our very own Intrepid Academy. On top of that, real-world experience such as leading clients, working with advanced tech, and mastering best-in-class processes will accelerate your growth every step of the way. Surrounded by a talented team that raises the bar daily, in a rapidly growing and ever-expanding business, the opportunities for your development are endless.

  • Rewarding You Right

    We believe great work deserves great rewards at Intrepid. That’s why we offer competitive compensation and generous benefits, including comprehensive insurance and ample leave, to support you both in and out of the workplace. We want you to feel valued, cared for, and empowered to bring your best self to work every day.

  • Lead structured process discovery workshops across departments (Operations, Commercial, Customer Support, and Finance).
  • Map end-to-end workflows to identify manual, repetitive, error-prone, or time-consuming activities suitable for automation.
  • Quantify baseline metrics including effort, volume, cycle time, error rates, and operational risk.
  • Build and maintain a prioritized AI Automation Opportunity Backlog, factoring in ROI and impact assessments.
AI Solution Design & Architecture
  • Design end-to-end AI solutions, including AI agents and copilots, workflow automations, and intelligent system integrations.
  • Evaluate and implement the most optimal mix of GenAI/LLMs, workflow orchestration, rules engines, and system integrations to address defined business use cases.
  • Leverage platforms and tools such as n8n, Langflow, OpenAI / Gemini agents, internal and external APIs, and internal tech systems to architect end to end solutions.
  • Rapidly develop proof-of-concepts (POCs) to validate technical feasibility and business impact for the identified use cases.
Implementation, Adoption & Scale
  • Run pilots, proactively collect user feedback, iterate quickly, and drive adoption to the focus group to validate business impact before scaling the solution across teams or regions.
  • Collaborate with Tech teams to transition validated use cases into production-grade, scalable solutions for company wide rollout.
  • Drive change management by developing SOP updates, training materials, and enablement sessions to ensure adoption.
Measurement, Governance & Reporting
  • Define and track impact metrics, including: Hours saved, Cost reduction, SLA improvements, Error reduction and User adoption and satisfaction.
  • Produce and present monthly AI & Automation Impact Reports to senior leadership.
  • Contribute to AI governance, best practices, and responsible AI adoption across the organization.

What we are looking for - the ideal profile

Technical & AI Capabilities
  • Hands-on experience with Generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, or automation platforms.
  • Working knowledge of Python or other scripting languages and no/low-code automation tools (e.g., n8n, Langflow etc.).
  • Solid understanding of APIs, webhooks, databases, and system integrations.
  • Experience applying AI within e-commerce, retail operations, or marketplace ecosystems.
Consulting, Problem-Solving & Communication
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to deconstruct complex operational workflows into actionable solutions.
  • Experience leading stakeholder workshops, conducting interviews, and synthesizing insights.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to bridge business and technical audiences.
  • Curiosity and discipline to stay current with emerging AI technologies and apply them into real-world applications.
  • Proven experience building ROI cases and prioritization frameworks.
Preferred Experience
  • 4+ years of hands-on experience delivering measurable impact through consulting, process improvement, automation, digital transformation, or AI initiatives.
  • Prior exposure to:
    • E-commerce industry, e.g. Marketplaces (Shopee, Lazada, TikTok)
    • Direct-to-consumer operations
    • Logistics & fulfillment
    • Finance reconciliation and reporting workflows
  • Experience working in fast-paced, multi-market or regional organizations is a strong plus.
  • Team management experience

In return, you will be getting

  • Shape how AI is applied at regional scale across a leading e-commerce enabler of 1000+ employees in south east asia
  • Work on real, high-impact problems at scale—delivering real outcomes, not fluffy documents or experimental side projects.
  • Play a pivotal role in shaping Intrepid’s next-generation, AI-powered operating model.
  • Tech is a strategic pillar for intrepid, so you will feel the love and recognition for your work, and will partner closely with business stakeholders, who as internal users of the tech will provide the real-world feedback and inputs which help to take our tech stack to the next level

We also offer

Best of Both Worlds

We are a scale up: the sophistication of a small multinational, with the agility of a start-up. This means you get to work on cutting-edge projects, and besides your 'standard' job description, we love to see you show entrepreneurial initiative and want to see your take on how you can take your role and our company to the next level. Good ideas get implemented. You are the master of your own destiny.

Culture that Brings Out the Best

At Intrepid, culture is not just a buzzword, it is what we practice at work every day. We believe in collaboration over competition, transparency over politics, and willingness to learn over ego. You will be part of a team where people genuinely support one another, celebrate wins together, and face challenges head-on as one. We put our all into the work but we balance it with fun, whether that is through team lunches, after-work hangouts, events or shared laughter in the office. This is a place where you can thrive professionally while having a great time.

Grow Without Limits

Learning at Intrepid is constant and dynamic. You will have access to formal training through face-to-face sessions, coaching and our very own Intrepid Academy. On top of that, real-world experience such as leading clients, working with advanced tech, and mastering best-in-class processes will accelerate your growth every step of the way. Surrounded by a talented team that raises the bar daily, in a rapidly growing and ever-expanding business, the opportunities for your development are endless.

Rewarding You Right

We believe great work deserves great rewards at Intrepid. That’s why we offer competitive compensation and generous benefits, including comprehensive insurance and ample leave, to support you both in and out of the workplace. We want you to feel valued, cared for, and empowered to bring your best self to work every day.

ad.title: Quality Control Officer (Data Centre)
ad.description:
Roles & Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

1. Quality Assurance & Process Compliance

  • Review and ensure all FM processes, SOPs, EOPs, workflows, and checklists comply with ISO standards, client requirements, and industry best practices.

  • Validate that operational activities align with approved procedures and the QMS framework.

  • Assist in the preparation, implementation, and improvement of quality assurance policies and guidelines.

2. QMS Support & Continuous Improvement

  • Support the Quality Manager in maintaining ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, and SS 564 documentation and compliance.

  • Participate in QMS reviews, gap analysis, and process enhancement initiatives.

  • Coordinate change management for document revisions, version control, and procedural updates.

3. Audit & Compliance Monitoring

  • Assist in planning and conducting internal audits, compliance assessments, and vendor audits.

  • Track audit findings, NCRs, and corrective/preventive actions (CAPA) to ensure timely closure.

  • Verify vendor service reports, statutory compliance certificates, and maintenance documentation.

4. Data Validation & Performance Monitoring

  • Analyse FM performance metrics such as PPM completion, incident response times, SLA compliance, energy consumption, downtime, and operational trends.

  • Validate accuracy of CMMS/CAFM entries, inspection logs, permit-to-work records, and maintenance data.

  • Prepare QA dashboards and reports for management and clients.

5. Vendor & Contractor Assurance

  • Ensure vendor processes, method statements, competencies, and documentation meet QA expectations before work execution.

  • Conduct random checks to ensure alignment to contract specifications and safety requirements.

  • Review and ensure close-out of service reports, service quality issues, and material compliance.

6. Incident & Risk Governance

  • Support root cause analysis for incidents, faults, and non-conformances.

  • Track incident trends and recommend preventive measures.

  • Maintain accurate records for incident reports, near-miss logs, and risk registers.

7. Documentation & Reporting

  • Maintain QA records, audit logs, compliance matrices, risk logs, and QMS documents.

  • Prepare weekly/monthly QA reports highlighting issues, recurring gaps, audit results, and corrective actions.

  • Ensure documentation readiness for client audits, certification audits, and regulatory inspections.

Requirements

Qualifications

  • Diploma/Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Facilities Management, Quality, or related engineering disciplines.

  • ISO 9001 Internal Auditor or Lead Auditor certificate is an advantage.

  • Familiarity with TIA-942, SS 564, SS 553, SS 568, and DC/mission-critical standards is beneficial.

Experience

  • 2–4 years of experience in FM, building services, QA/QC, industrial operations, or critical infrastructure.

  • Experience in data centres or mission-critical facilities is preferred.

  • Knowledge of key M&E systems (GRUPS, generator, chillers, switchgear, CRAC/CRAH, BMS) is desirable.

Skills

  • Strong analytical and documentation skills.

  • High attention to detail and accuracy.

  • Able to identify gaps in processes and propose improvements.

  • Effective communicator with technicians, engineers, vendors, and clients.

  • Proficient in MS Office, CAFM/CMMS, and quality reporting tools (Power BI is a plus).

Location
- Ang Mo Kio

ad.title: Shift Technician (Data Centre)
ad.description:
Roles & Responsibilities

The Rotating Shift Technician is responsible for supporting 24×7 data centre operations, ensuring the reliability, safety, and continuity of all Mechanical & Electrical (M&E), critical infrastructure, and facilities systems in accordance with approved procedures, service level agreements (SLAs), and safety requirements.

·      Perform continuous monitoring, routine patrols, and inspection of data centre infrastructure, critical facilities, and associated equipment.

·      Manage day-to-day maintenance coordination, and escalate any critical troubleshooting requirements that needs to be conducted by manufacturers.

·      Conduct routine checks of M&E and critical systems performance.

·      Record and report daily operating conditions, abnormalities, and system status.

·      Supervise and oversee OEMs, subcontractors, and service vendors performing works on electrical, mechanical, fire, and critical facilities systems.

·      Ensure all vendors deliver competent, safe, and quality services in compliance with contractual obligations, site rules, and safety requirements.

·      Coordinate and monitor scheduled and ad-hoc vendor activities, ensuring proper documentation and work completion.

·      Promptly respond to incidents, alarms, and emergency situations.

·      Execute incident escalation in accordance with approved escalation matrices and emergency response procedures.

·      Provide standby and emergency support when activated, including shift stand-in or additional coverage as required.

·     Ensure proper handover and takeover of duties during shift changes.

·      Carry out duties that comply with approved SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures), MOPs (Method of Procedures), and EOPs (Emergency Operating Procedures).

·      Carry out all work strictly in accordance with site processes, operational governance, and safety regulations.

ad.title: Data Centre Mechanical Engineer
ad.description:
Roles & Responsibilities

Job Description

1.     Perform detailed cooling load calculations and thermal analysis for data halls, including rack-level heat load assessments.

2.     Design, review, and optimize ACMV systems, including:

- CRAC/CRAH units

- Chilled water systems

- Cooling towers and pumps

3.     Lead and support cooling system upgrades and retrofits, ensuring minimal disruption to live data center operations.

4.     Evaluate system performance using KPIs such as:

o  Power Usage Effectiveness

o  System Efficiency

5.     Conduct energy optimization studies and recommend improvements (e.g., air flow management, containment strategies, setpoint optimization).

6.     Support capacity planning and future expansion work based on IT load growth.

7.     Review engineering drawings, method statements, and ensure compliance with design intent and operational requirements.

8.     Work closely with operations teams to implement EOPs/MOPs for mechanical system interventions.

9.     Participate in risk assessments, failure mode analysis, and incident investigations related to cooling systems.

10.  Ensure all works comply with relevant standards and regulatory requirements in Singapore

Required Qualifications
1.     Bachelor’s Degree / Degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field

2.     Additional certifications relevant to theindustry is an added advantage 

3.     1-2 years’ experience maintainingelectrical, mechanical, fire protection system in a data centre environment

4.     Experience and knowledge of MEP equipmentsuch as CAHU, CRAC, ACMV systems, pumps, cooling towers, UPS, generators, etc.

5.     Strong technical expertise in thermalmanagement, cooling load calculations, and energy efficiency improvements,supporting design and upgrading of cooling systems in data centre environments.

6.     Strong problem-solving abilities,communication skills, and the ability to work independently and as part of ateam

7.     Strong written and verbal communicationskills

8.     Proficient in Computer skills eg.Microsoft office, google emails , docs etc.

9.     Shift work & Standby Duty is required(Shift allowance available)

ad.title: Senior Facility Manager
ad.description:
Job Description

Organization, co-ordinate and control the in-house team and appointed sub-contractors.
  • Collate and manage all technical specifications, O&M documentation, drawings and compile all maintenance programs from all sub-contractors.
  • Track and monitor the maintenance programs by using the appropriate software and spreadsheets.
  • Manage emergency and ad-hoc repairs, breakdowns and trouble-shooting.
  • Provide technical support and attendance where necessary and act as an Authorized Person.
  • Manage and act as the co-ordination point between the various subcontractors and/or Vendors appointed by the Board.
  • Manage and oversee building / facilities management contracts to ensure that the service delivery and contractual obligations are delivered and executed in a manner that fosters and achieves customer satisfaction.
  • Consolidate and provide technical reports or findings to the Board.
  • Oversee the health and safety management.
  • Ensure Permit-to-Work (PTW) is approved and proper submission of all risk assessment reports by all sub-contractors, including those appointed by the Board, before the works are executed, proper filing of the reports and implement inspection and spot checks to ensure compliance to risk assessment by the sub-contractors.
  • Works management such as preparing monthly progress reports, certification of work completed to the required standard, issue and control of variation orders, etc.
  • Assist in the day to day ‘running’ of the Property.
  • Carry out periodical and statutory inspections in an agreed format and manner with the Board and provision of management reports thereafter.
  • Shall manage customer service-related issues, ensure proper response and action items with customers (any tenants / Occupant / staff or members of public) are closed in a timely and professional manner.
  • Also be responsible for the office management functions, office support services and administrative support to the Board.
  • Any other work necessary for effective operations of the Property.

Job Requirements

  • Degree from recognized tertiary establishment in Facility Management / Mechanical Engineering/ Electrical Engineering/ Building Services.
  • 5 years relevant experience in Facilities Operation in FM service provider.
  • Good interpersonal soft skills and verbal & written communication.
  • Good working knowledge and understanding of maintenance and contracts.
  • FSM / SCEM / other FM and Safety related certificates will have added advantage.
Location: Marina Barrage

  • Prefer with construction industry background.

  • Good communication and interpersonal skills
  • 5.5 work days
  • Location is at Shan Road

ad.title: Mechanical Technician
ad.description:
Overview

Element has an opportunity for a Mechanical Technician to join our growing team. This is a great opportunity to develop your career within a Global TIC business.


Responsibilities

  • Interpretation of internal and client requirements
  • Supervising allocated staff and being responsible for the day to day management of the relevant discipline
  • Operating complex mechanical testing equipment
  • Maintaining accurate and systematic records
  • Performing other duties to fulfil the demands of the laboratory
  • Performing general duties in accordance with Element's internal procedures, quality as well as Health and Safety system
  • Application of instrumentation and the setting up of complex data capture equipment
  • Report writing, data interpretation and analysis

Skills / Qualifications

  • Educated to a good general standard including English and Maths
  • Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or relevant / experience in related (testing laboratory)
  • Hands-on job
  • Sound mechanical bias
  • Previous experience in an appropriate Engineering environment is a distinct advantage
  • Experience of working within a Mechanical testing environment is advantageous
  • An understanding of a recognised Quality Management Systems such as ISO 17025 is beneficial
  • Self motivated Technician with the ability to multi task, organise and work under the pressure of a busy commercial mechanical test laboratory
  • Excellent attention to detail
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • A team player attitude
  • Excellent analytical and problem solving skills

#LI-CL1


Company Overview

Element is one of the fastest growing testing, inspection and certification businesses in the world. Globally we have more than 9,000 brilliant minds operating from 270 sites across 30 countries. Together we share an ambitious purpose to ‘Make tomorrow safer than today’.

When failure in use is not an option, we help customers make certain that their products, materials, processes and services are safe, compliant and fit for purpose. From early R&D, through complex regulatory approvals and into production, our global laboratory network of scientists, engineers, and technologists support customers to achieve assurance over product quality, sustainable outcomes, and market access.

While we are proud of our global reach, working at Element feels like being part of a smaller company. We empower you to take charge of your career, and reward excellence and integrity with growth and development.

Industries across the world depend on our care, attention to detail and the absolute accuracy of our work. The role we have to play in creating a safer world is much bigger than our organization.

Diversity Statement

At Element, we always take pride in putting our people first. We are an equal opportunity employer that recognizes diversity and inclusion as fundamental to our Vision of becoming “the world’s most trusted testing partner”.

 

All suitably qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment on the basis of objective work related criteria and without regard for the following: age, disability, ethnic origin, gender, marital status, race, religion, responsibility of dependents, sexual orientation, or gender identity or other characteristics in accordance with the applicable governing laws or other characteristics in accordance with the applicable governing laws.

ad.title: Chemistry Technician
ad.description:
Overview

Element has an opportunity for a Chemistry Technician for testing, sample preparation and delivery/collection of samples and preparation of test reports.

Responsibilities

  • Analysis of water-physical, chemical and microbiological parameters
  • Analysis of ores and minerals
  • Analysis of water, soil, aggregates, concrete and scale samples
  • Operation of equipment like pH / EC / TDS meters, UV-visible spectrophotometers, ovens, furnaces, incubators, fusion machines
  • Prepare the reagents, standard solution and ensure standardisation of the solution used in the laboratory
  • Handling and storage all chemicals as per the Material Safety Data Sheet (MSDS)
  • Managing the calibration of glass wares and the instruments
  • Performance of qualitative and quantitative laboratory tests and analysis of other substances as per standard method
  • Issue reports and receive samples to and from the respective entities
  • Involvement in site and field testing with various international standards or in-house procedures
  • Ensure work compliance to ISO 17025 requirements
  • Coordinating with the other technicians in the team to carry out work as per the planning schedule
  • Manual handling of samples
  • General maintenance, cleaning and checking of equipment
  • Working to all HSE standards
  • Interaction with clients during witnessed testing
  • Generating test reports for clients (data entry, quality assurance)
  • Ensuring compliance to all Element Material Technology quality standards
  • Driving to customer site to collect samples and / or conduct testing at their lab on a regular / daily basis
  • Willing to assist in other activities from time to time that may be requested by the department manager to assist in the execution of Element Material Technology annual targets and budget

Skills / Qualifications

  • Have a diploma / degree in chemistry with at least 2 years experience in similar role
  • Have the ability to work in teams under pressure and flexible to work different working hours (night / day) shifts if required or necessary
  • Good English communication skills: reading, writing, speaking
  • Good maths skills
  • Knowledge and experience of safe operation of testing equipment and operating in an independent / chemistry / consultant laboratory

ad.title: Associate Test Technician
ad.description:
Overview

Element has an opportunity for Associate Test Technician to join our rapidly expanding team. As a member of the operations team in one of the various laboratories across Element, the Associate Test Technician position performs a variety of routine and non-routine testing assignments within the department assigned and insures timely and accurate test results under direct supervision.

The technician positions must be proficient in a number of core business skills including but not limited to compliance to established safety rules, code of conduct, and company policies and procedures.


Responsibilities

  • Perform varies of construction testing onsite such as concrete, soil, structural fixings and etc.
  • Perform test as directed by customer specification / Engineer’s instruction
  • Operate testing independently and /or under supervision of senior test technician
  • Gather and record test data and able to communicates properly with client onsite.
  • Prepare and compile reports/worksheets as per supervisor’s instruction

Skills / Qualifications

  • Working knowledge of laboratory safety & site safety.
  • HS diploma or GED certificate preferred. College or vocational school coursework welcomed
  • 0-2 years’ experience in a testing related field
  • Basic understanding of testing concepts
  • Possess computer skills.
  • Ability to apply concepts of basic algebra and geometry a plus

  • Frequency of required physical force: Minimum (moderate).
  • Lifting requirements: lifting <50 lbs. often and > 50 lbs. on occasion

Element has an opportunity for an Engineer to join our rapidly expanding team. As a member of the operations team, the Engineer position performs a variety of routine and non-routine testing assignments within the department assigned and insures timely and accurate test results under minimal direct supervision.

The engineer position must be proficient in a number of core business and technical skills including but not limited to compliance to established safety rules, code of conduct, and company policies and procedures.

  • Assist in the professional development of novice technicians and engineers

ad.title: Data Processor (MY)
ad.description:
Overview

Element has an opportunity for a Data Processor to join our rapidly expanding team. As a member of the operations team in one of the various laboratories across Element, the Data Processer position primarily responsible for assisting in designing, planning, and coordinating geotechnical instrumentation projects, scheduling control, obtaining permits for on-site installation, and setting up and commissioning monitoring.

This role is based in Johor Bahru, Malaysia.


Responsibilities

  • Receive and review field data (borehole logs, CPT, SPT, rock coring, etc.) from site engineers/ geologist.
  • Compile lab test results (e.g., moisture content, Atterberg limits, triaxial, consolidation tests).
  • Validate data accuracy against site records and laboratory logs
  • Generate borehole logs using software such as AutoCAD, Geosmart
  • Work closely with geotechnical engineers, drafters, lab technicians, and field staff & follow up with external laboratories or drilling contractors for missing data or clarifications.
  • Data processing for field test such as Permeability Test, Packer Test, Pressuremeter Test, Vane Shear Test, CPT
  • Align reports with project specifications, national standards (e.g., ASTM, BS, IS codes), and local regulatory requirements
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to spot inconsistencies in data.
  • Familiarity with common soil types in Singapore
  • Ability to work under pressure to meet submission deadlines
  • Update project managers on report status and highlight any delays or issues
  • Support revisions and feedback from engineers and clients promptly and professionally
  • Perform quality checks on all data inputs and report outputs

Skills / Qualifications

  • Minimum Degree in Civil Engineering or Geotechnical Engineering or Geology
  • Working experience in geotechnical instrumentation and site investigation works would be advantageous
  • Able to withstand the challenging working conditions
  • Strong and determined quality focus with indefatigable determination to get the job done under the most challenging conditions
  • Self-motivated team player with excellent organisational and communication skills


#LI-CL1

ad.title: Quantity Surveyor
ad.description:
Overview

Element has an opportunity for a Quantity Surveyor to join our growing team. This is a great opportunity to develop your career within a Global TIC business.

This role is based in Johor Bahru

Responsibilities

  • Prepare technical and commercial proposals during tender stage including bills of quantities material quantity and taking off quantities, attend site show round, site visit, attend tender briefing, seeks clarifications with respective client/ consultant if any.
  • Study details and discuss with management, attend tender interviews including method statement, technical proposal presentation and tender clarification.
  • Manpower and resources budgeting, monthly monitoring, review and update.
  • Prepare pricing of bill of quantity and re-measurement works.
  • Assist in establishing a client's requirements and coordinate quality controls to ensure deliverables meet requirements.
  • Monitor tender/quotation results, check tender/quotation status via Gebiz and inform management; for private tender/quotation, to follow-up closely with client.
  • Collaborate with client for kick off meeting and attend kick off meeting with project team Prepare handing over and brief project details scope with project team, review contract documents.
  • Evaluate and handle all contractual issues, variation orders, insurances/bond and render support/advice to project team.
  • Conduct cost analysis, manage project timeline and cost conduct commercial negotiations.
  • Attending site visit to monitor site progress and performance.
  • In charge of preparing progress claim submission, variation orders to client and handling subcontractors’ claims.
  • Call for a quotation from supplier and/or subcon if necessary.
  • Assist in material/equipment procurement, inventory, and general administration task other duties as may be assigned on a need basis requirement.
  • Preparation of technical details & costing for tender submission.
  • Handle progress claims and progress payment, verifying payment to sub-contractors, ensuring all variations to contract are captured and tracking variation orders.
  • Conduct cost analysis, manage project timeline and cost, conduct commercial negotiations.
  • Liaise and establish rapport with consultants, quantity surveyors, developers, and contractors on certification of claims for payments.
  • Other ad-hoc duties as assigned.

Skills / Qualifications

  • Diploma or Degree in Quantity Surveying, Civil Engineering, or related field.
  • Minimum 2–3 years in QS or cost management roles; experience in building or M&E projects preferred.

Skills:

  • Strong knowledge of cost estimation, tendering, and contract administration.
  • Familiarity with standard forms of contract
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel) and QS software
  • Excellent analytical, negotiation, and communication skills.
  • Professional Membership preferred

ad.title: Technician (Calibration)
ad.description:
Overview

Element has an opportunity for an Associate Engineer to join our rapidly expanding team. As a member of the operations team, the Engineer position performs a variety of routine and non-routine testing assignments within the department assigned and insures timely and accurate test results under minimal direct supervision. 

 

This role is based in Ang Mo Kio, Singapore.

Responsibilities

  • Perform Calibration and Measurement of Dimension gauges and instruments as per WI using CMM, reference master, tester etc (on-site and in-house) with report and necessary administrative work
  • Conduct routine maintenance and calibration of lab equipment as schedule and assigned
  • Ensure proper delivery of service to customer(s)
  • Help manager to manage day-to-day calibration work in the labs reference to ISO17025 standard, eg. Quality/ Job Planning/ Job Assignment/ Customer Requirements etc
  • Any other duties as assigned by Manager/ Section Head/ Senior staff

• ITE/GCE/ Diploma in Aerospace/ Precision / Mechanical Engineering etc

• Ability to read and understand technical drawing and GD&T.
• Ability to analyze and compile Calibration / testing data from the Calibration/ tests performed
• Good to have 2 to 3 years CMM knowledge.
• Good to have ISO17025 and measurement uncertainty knowledge
• Possess strong computer skills
• Basic Mathematical Skills. Ability to apply concepts of basic algebra and geometry a plus

ad.title: Associate Chemist
ad.description:
Overview

Element has an opportunity for a Chemistry Technician for testing, sample preparation and delivery/collection of samples and preparation of test reports.

Responsibilities

  • Analysis of water-physical, chemical and microbiological parameters
  • Analysis of ores and minerals
  • Analysis of water, soil, aggregates, concrete and scale samples
  • Operation of equipment like pH / EC / TDS meters, UV-visible spectrophotometers, ovens, furnaces, incubators, fusion machines
  • Prepare the reagents, standard solution and ensure standardisation of the solution used in the laboratory
  • Handling and storage all chemicals as per the Material Safety Data Sheet (MSDS)
  • Managing the calibration of glass wares and the instruments
  • Performance of qualitative and quantitative laboratory tests and analysis of other substances as per standard method
  • Issue reports and receive samples to and from the respective entities
  • Involvement in site and field testing with various international standards or in-house procedures
  • Ensure work compliance to ISO 17025 requirements
  • Coordinating with the other technicians in the team to carry out work as per the planning schedule
  • Manual handling of samples
  • General maintenance, cleaning and checking of equipment
  • Working to all HSE standards
  • Interaction with clients during witnessed testing
  • Generating test reports for clients (data entry, quality assurance)
  • Ensuring compliance to all Element Material Technology quality standards
  • Driving to customer site to collect samples and / or conduct testing at their lab on a regular / daily basis
  • Willing to assist in other activities from time to time that may be requested by the department manager to assist in the execution of Element Material Technology annual targets and budget

Skills / Qualifications

  • Have a diploma / degree in chemistry with at least 2 years experience in similar role
  • Have the ability to work in teams under pressure and flexible to work different working hours (night / day) shifts if required or necessary
  • Good English communication skills: reading, writing, speaking
  • Good maths skills
  • Knowledge and experience of safe operation of testing equipment and operating in an independent / chemistry / consultant laboratory

ad.title: IoT Engineer
ad.description:
Overview

Element is looking for a skilled and proactive IoT Engineer to assess, implement, and maintain IoT-based geotechnical instrumentation systems. In this role, you will be responsible for selecting and integrating sensors and communications devices, managing data pipelines, and ensuring reliable data acquisition for structural and geotechnical monitoring. This role bridges hardware deployment, cloud integration, and data integrity, supporting real-time alerting and reporting systems for engineering decision-making.

 

This role is based in Kaki Bukit, Singapore.

Responsibilities

Sensor setup and system design

  • Design, implement and maintain IoT sensor networks and data acquisition systems for geotechnical applications (e.g., piezometers, inclinometers, strain gauges, total stations, etc.)
  • Identify and specify field data acquisition hardware such as nodes, loggers and gateways & select, assess, configure, and maintain sensors and communication devices for accurate data acquisition

Data Acquisition, Transformation, and Management

  • Build and manage data pipelines from edge devices to cloud on on-premise-hosted databases & implement transformation logic for raw sensor data based on project-specific rules
  • Ensure data quarantine and release workflows, and alert rules and escalations are correctly programmed and integrated & collaborate with field teams to set up data monitoring systems for projects
  • Ensure secure data transmission and storage using best practices & monitor system health and uptime of IoT infrastructure

Collaboration & Reporting

  • Work with IT Engineers and other Instrumentation Engineers and Surveyors to develop dashboards and ensure seamless data flow & support reporting automation and data visualization efforts
  • Provide technical documentation and training for field teams and stakeholders

Skills / Qualifications

  • Diploma or Degree in Electronics, Mechatronics, Computer Engineering, Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related field

  • Certifications in IoT, data engineering, cloud platforms (Azure, AWS), or communications protocols are a plus

    Skills & Experience

  • Experience with IoT protocols (MQTT, FTP), sensor integration, and embedded systems

  • Familiarity with SQL databases, data transformation logic, and cloud services

  • Knowledge of geotechnical instrumentation is highly desirable

  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills in field deployments and data flow
